_comment: Game script components that instantiate a prefab under their game object when the scene starts: the scene viewer
loads the prefab as a linked document there, as it loads a folder's linked scene.
Keyed by component type name. 'prefab' is the field path to the via.Prefab's Path (through objects, each step a
field name), at the highest graphics settings. 'children', when present, lists per-child overrides the component
applies to the instantiated prefab: 'list' the array field, 'name' the name of a child of the prefab's root (the
first so named), 'draw' its draw switch, applied as that child's DrawSelf.
RE4 (2026-10-18): chainsaw.PropsPrefabGenerator spawns each stage's visible foliage (st*_FoliageGroup.pfb; the
scene places only the shadow-casting _Shadow group). _LowPCPropsPrefabController is the low-PC preset's choice.
Read from re4_dump.exe (2026-10-18): applyRequestedState finds each _ChildName by a path relative to the spawned
object (a bare name: its child) and calls share.GameObjectStateSetMediator.requestSetState(child, update None,
draw _DrawState, layer 1), whose applier sets the child's DrawSelf (via.GameObject +0x13) to 'no layer holds
